grammar.k: 情态动词 can 和 can't 的用法
grammar.f: 主语 + can/can't + 动词原形
grammar.d: can表示能力或可能性，can't表示不能或不允许 用于询问或陈述能力、请求许可、表达可能性。疑问句将can提前。
ex: Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday?
您能星期一上午10点来吗？
Can't you wait till this afternoon?
The dentist can't see me now.

grammar.k: 一般现在时与现在进行时
grammar.f: 主语 + 动词原形/动词+s / 主语 + am/is/are + 动词-ing
grammar.d: 一般现在时描述习惯性动作，现在进行时描述正在发生的动作 一般现在时用于经常性的动作，现在进行时用于正在进行的动作
ex: The dentist is very busy at the moment.

grammar.d: 描述过去发生的动作或存在的状态 用于叙述过去发生的事情

patterns.p: Can you come at + 时间?
o: Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?
您能4月24日星期一上午10点来吗？
im: Can you come at 3 p.m. tomorrow?

patterns.p: I want to see the + 职业, please.
o: I want to see the dentist, please.
im: I want to see the doctor, please.
I want to see the manager, please.

o: I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.
im: I'm afraid that she isn't here.
I'm afraid that the shop is closed.

patterns.p: 主语 + can't wait, but + 主语 + can't (either).
o: I can wait, but my toothache can't!
我能等，但我的牙疼不能等！
im: I can work, but my computer can't!
我能工作，但我的电脑不能！
